services.desc: Join docents from the Gamble House in Pasadena as they host drop-in talks that take place in the Greene & Greene Gallery at the Huntington at 11:30 a.m., 12:30 p.m., and 1:30 p.m. The Gamble House living room rugs are unique and artistic elements of the house.
